Task: Federated Login Flow

Write Python code that handles the callback and exchanges an authorization code for tokens using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text: import os from authlib.integrations.requests_client import OAuth2Session from flask import Flask, request, redirect, url_for, session app = Flask(__name__) app.secret_key = os.urandom(24) # Environment variables for Auth0 AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN") AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID") AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET") AUTH0_CALLBACK_URL = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CALLBACK_URL", "http://localhost:5000/callback") AUTH0_API_AUDIENCE = os.environ.get("AUTH0_API_AUDIENCE") # Optional, for APIs @app.route("/") def index(): if "user" in session: return f"Hello, {session['user']['name']}! Logout" return "Welcome! Login with Auth0" @app.route("/login") def login(): session["nonce"] = os.urandom(16).hex() # Store a nonce for ID token validation authorize_url = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/authorize?" \ f"audience={AUTH0_API_AUDIENCE}&" \ f"scope=openid%20profile%20email&" \ f"response_type=code&" \ f"client_id={AUTH0_CLIENT_ID}&" \ f"redirect_uri={AUTH0_CALLBACK_URL}&" \ f"nonce={session['nonce']}" # Pass nonce return redirect(authorize_url) @app.route("/callback") def callback(): code = request.args.get("code") if not code: return "Error: No authorization code received", 400 token_endpoint = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/oauth/token" client_auth = (AUTH0_CLIENT_ID, AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET) try: oauth = OAuth2Session( client_id=AUTH0_CLIENT_ID, client_secret=AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET, redirect_uri=AUTH0_CALLBACK_URL, scope="openid profile email" ) token_response = oauth.fetch_token( token_endpoint, authorization_response=request.url, verify=True, nonce=session.get("nonce") # Pass nonce for validation ) session["access_token"] = token_response["access_token"] session["id_token"] = token_response["id_token"] # Decode ID token to get user info (for demonstration purposes, proper validation recommended) import jwt id_token_payload = jwt.decode( token_response["id_token"], options={"verify_signature": False} # IMPORTANT: For production, you MUST verify the signature and audience ) session["user"] = { "name": id_token_payload.get("name") or id_token_payload.get("email"), "sub": id_token_payload["sub"] } return redirect(url_for("index")) except Exception as e: app.logger.error(f"Error during token exchange: {e}") return f"Error exchanging code for tokens: {e}", 500 @app.route("/logout") def logout(): session.pop("user", None) session.pop("access_token", None) session.pop("id_token", None) # Redirect to Auth0 logout endpoint to clear Auth0 session as well auth0_logout_url = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/v2/logout?" \ f"client_id={AUTH0_CLIENT_ID}&" \ f"returnTo={url_for('index', _external=True)}" return redirect(auth0_logout_url) if __name__ == "__main__": app.run(debug=True)
